meta.name: backtesting-frameworks
meta.description: Build robust backtesting systems for trading strategies with proper handling of look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, and transaction costs. Use when developing trading algorithms, validating strategies, or building backtesting infrastructure.

copy.tagline: 搭建交易回测系统，校验策略可靠性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发量化交易策略并需要严谨的回测验证。
copy.tagline_en: Build reliable backtesting systems to validate trading strategies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're developing quant trading strategies and need rigorous backtesting.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按规范搭建回测系统:将数据分成训练/验证/测试三段,用 walk-forward 检验参数,并给出事件驱动、向量化等 Python 回测器代码,处理前视偏差、幸存者偏差和交易成本。
howto.when: 当你在开发交易算法、验证策略表现,或搭建回测系统时,该技能会触发。

say.text: 帮我搭一个事件驱动的回测器,算上滑点和手续费
say.note: Claude 会给出可运行的 Python 回测代码

say.text: 用向量化回测我的均线策略,给出收益和回撤
say.note: Claude 会输出权益曲线和回撤等指标

say.text: 对我的策略参数做 walk-forward 优化
say.note: Claude 会拆分训练/测试窗口并搜索最优参数

howto.what_en: After install, Claude builds backtesting systems: splits data into train/validation/test, uses walk-forward analysis, and provides event-driven and vectorized backtester code, handling look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, and transaction costs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are developing trading algorithms, validating strategies, or building backtesting infrastructure.

say_en.text: Build an event-driven backtester with slippage and commissions.
say_en.note: Claude provides runnable Python backtest code.

say_en.text: Vector-backtest my moving-average strategy; give return and drawdown.
say_en.note: Claude outputs the equity curve and drawdown metrics.

say_en.text: Run walk-forward optimization on my strategy parameters.
say_en.note: Claude splits train/test and searches optimal params.
